title: Migrate Ingress Traffic to Gateway HTTPRoute
prompt:
Namespace `cka-migrate` runs workload `store` exposed by Service `store-svc` on port `80`, along with an existing `Gateway` named `store-gw` (`gatewayClassName: eg`). Legacy Ingress routing must be replaced with Gateway API.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Create an `HTTPRoute` named `store-route` in namespace `cka-migrate` attached to `parentRefs` `store-gw` matching hostname `store.cka.local`.
2. Route requests to Service `store-svc` on port `80` with prefix match `/`.
3. Delete the legacy Ingress `store-legacy` in namespace `cka-migrate`.
hints: HTTPRoute specifies `parentRefs: [{name: store-gw}]`, `hostnames: [store.cka.local]`, and `backendRefs: [{name: store-svc, port: 80}]`.
Remember to run `k -n cka-migrate delete ingress store-legacy` after applying `store-route`.
fast_solution_commands: k -n cka-migrate get gateway store-gw -o yaml

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: store
  namespace: cka-migrate
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: store
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: store
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: store-svc
  namespace: cka-migrate
spec:
  selector:
    app: store
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 80
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: store-legacy
  namespace: cka-migrate
  labels:
    legacy: "true"
spec:
  rules:
  - host: store.cka.local
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: store-svc
            port:
              number: 80
---
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: store-gw
  namespace: cka-migrate
spec:
  gatewayClassName: eg
  listeners:
  - name: http
    protocol: HTTP
    port: 80
    hostname: store.cka.local
    allowedRoutes:
      namespaces:
        from: Same

apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: store-route
  namespace: cka-migrate
spec:
  parentRefs:
  - name: store-gw
  hostnames:
  - store.cka.local
  rules:
  - matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /
    backendRefs:
    - name: store-svc
      port: 80
